Title: Backup and restore for Azure Web Sites

Body.Content:
Save a snapshot version of your web app (along with any SQL or MySQL databases it uses) and start your site backup. You decide when a backup starts - manually, or automatically on a schedule you choose (for example, once a day at midnight).  Later, restore a website to a previous version, or create a new website based on one of your original site's backups.

Backup and Restore is available at no additional cost to all Web Site customers using our Standard Tier.
